Module io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations
Package io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.media

Annotation Interface Content

@Target(ANNOTATION_TYPE) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Inherited public @interface Content
The annotation may be used to define the content/media type of a parameter, request or response, by defining it as field Parameter.content(), RequestBody.content() or ApiResponse.content().

If schema() is defined, swagger-rest reader engine will consider it along with JAX-RS annotations, element type and context as input to resolve the annotated element into an OpenAPI schema definition for such element.
